name: Energization of an open 100 km line
description: 66 kV, 50 Hz source with Z1 = 0.5 + j5 ohm and Z0 = 1 + j15 ohm, switched at t = 0 with phase a at its peak onto a 100 km line that is open at bus b2. The line is a bergeron_line: travelling waves with 338 us in the line modes (Zc = 266 ohm) and 458 us in the zero-sequence mode (Zc = 655 ohm). The first front reaches b2 after 338 us; the waves are then reflected at the open end and at the source inductance with little damping, and phase a of b2 reaches about 2.4 times the peak of the source voltage. `openkeito scan` shows the resonances seen from b2 from 10 Hz to 5 kHz (the first ones at 633 Hz in the positive sequence and 469 Hz in the zero sequence).
